essence: The verse presents mantra as full I-reflection and supreme consciousness-power, not mere letters.
Unmade effort restrains first emergence and draws bindu into supreme light, giving mantra-user identity with mantra-deity.
The secret power of mantras is the pulsating existence of the body of vidyā, Bhagavan as the mass of words, whose nature is complete non-dual I-awareness.
Therefore limited powers and dream-like knowledge are obstacles unless transcended toward supreme attainment.
Khechari mudra is the innate state of consciousness, not a mechanical technique.
